motionPrompts.title: Recent form: wins, draws, defeats
motionPrompts.prompt:
Vertical 9:16 composition. The lower quarter stays permanently reserved for yellow burned-in subtitles; every graphic element sits above it inside the upper three quarters with generous side gutters. Palette: GoatLab charcoal #101412 ground, warm white #edf0e6 typography, lime #c5ed74 for the home side, slate #8ca6bf for the away side.

Editorial variant — kinetic typography with rhythmic emphasis. A Spanish heading, FORMA RECIENTE, snaps in as a heavy condensed uppercase title, then three Spanish labels — VICTORIAS, EMPATES, DERROTAS — stamp along a horizontal rhythm rail, each with a lime flash and a short scale overshoot. The same three words answer from the opposite side in slate, timed a fraction of a second later so the two teams read as call and response. This variant is purely typographic: no axes, no sample claim, no invented match events. Camera drifts slowly upward with light parallax, then settles. Transition: a diagonal lime wipe sweeps from lower left to upper right and clears the typography for the chart.

Statistical variant — grouped count bars. Two groups, Aston Villa FC and Brentford FC, three bars each in the order victorias, empates, derrotas, drawn on one shared zero baseline with a common scale in partidos. Gridlines every single unit, warm white value labels directly above each bar cap, Spanish axis unit label 'partidos'. The bars resolved from {{home.wins}}, {{home.draws}} and {{home.losses}} use lime; those resolved from {{away.wins}}, {{away.draws}} and {{away.losses}} use slate; the zero line is slate at reduced opacity. Under the baseline print the sample and source line 'Muestra: {{home.n}} y {{away.n}} partidos · Fuente: Bzzoiro', held at one third of the title size and kept legible. Both sample sizes are equal, so neither group is visually favoured. Bars grow from the baseline with a short ease-out, staggered 80 ms apart; the leading bar of each group takes a brief lime halo as the single focal point. Camera pushes in slightly. Transition: bars retract into the baseline and the group labels slide down toward the subtitle band. Exit: charcoal fades to black over 300 ms while subtitles persist.
